description: Use this skill when the user is running DOCA Perftest (doca_perftest), the RDMA benchmark that measures bandwidth, message rate and latency for RDMA verbs, point-to-point or across a cluster, with an optional DOCA Verbs backend (-r dv) or GPUNetIO engine (--engine gpunetio). Trigger even when the user does not say "DOCA Perftest" — implicit phrasings include "how do I benchmark RDMA write bandwidth with DOCA", "run ib_write_bw but across 8 nodes", "perftest says the device is busy", "my latency numbers differ between client and server", "launch the server over SSH", or "run an all-to-all RDMA test from a JSON scenario". Refuse and route elsewhere for DOCA install (doca-setup), DOCA Bench (doca-bench), and application-level throughput.
